standard_prerequisites.name: Conditions of the Cohen forcing used for COH
standard_prerequisites.statement: A condition is a pair (sigma, rho) with sigma a finite binary string and rho an M-finite approximation of the sequence of sets to be made cohesive, and it may be read as a Mathias condition; a string tau is compatible with (sigma, rho) when sigma is an initial segment of tau and the difference tau minus sigma is contained in the members of the approximation; the article's own account is retained at source lines 480-483.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the two objects of the counted lemma, namely a condition (sigma,rho) and the compatibility relation over which the recursive construction runs.

standard_prerequisites.name: The forcing relation for the existential and universal jump formulas
standard_prerequisites.statement: A condition forces the existential statement that some value of the functional on the generic is defined when a witness and a bound smaller than the length of sigma exist, and it forces the universal statement that all values diverge when every string compatible with the condition fails to converge anywhere; the article's own definition is retained at source lines 485-491, and its explanation of forcing a decided initial segment of the jump at source line 505.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma concludes a forcing statement about the generics G and Y, so the exact meaning of the forcing relation and of compatibility must be available; the proof uses the two clauses in its contradiction argument and its final transfer from conditions to generics.

standard_prerequisites.name: Theories Sigma^0_2 collection, Ramsey's theorem for singletons and well-foundedness
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof uses that a model M satisfying the collection scheme for Sigma^0_2 formulas satisfies the Ramsey theorem for singletons with k colours for every k, and that M satisfying WF(alpha) means that M has no M-infinite sequence of ordinals below alpha that decreases at every step; the article states both notations and uses them throughout.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof obtains an M-infinite homogeneous set for the colours given by the indices below k from the collection scheme, and the contradiction is the existence of an M-infinite alpha-decreasing sequence, which WF(alpha) forbids.

core_obligations: Normalise the functionals by twisting: assume that whenever Phi^sigma_e(n) converges, it also converges on every m below n and its values on 0 up to n form a strictly alpha-decreasing sequence (source lines 526-530).

Argue by contradiction: if the lemma fails, then for every M-finite string tau compatible with the condition and every n there are an extension tau_1 compatible with the condition and an index e below k with Phi^{tau_1 plus Y}(n) convergent (source line 532).

Build recursively in Y an increasing chain tau_0 an initial segment of tau_1 an initial segment of tau_2 and so on of strings compatible with the condition such that for every n some functional with index below k converges at n on tau_n (source lines 534-539).

Apply the collection scheme of M to get, for the finitely many colours given by the indices below k, an M-infinite homogeneous set Z inside M on which one fixed index e below k converges at every n (source lines 539-540).

Read off the contradiction: the values of the fixed functional along tau_n for n in Z form an M-infinite alpha-decreasing sequence, which contradicts the hypothesis that M satisfies WF(alpha); hence the failure assumption is false and some finite bound n together with an extension of the condition forces every functional below k to stop being an alpha-decreasing sequence beyond that length (source lines 542-543).

proof_roadmap.step: Twist the functionals so that convergence implies convergence and strict alpha-decrease on all smaller inputs.
Assume the lemma fails and extract, for every compatible finite string and every n, an extension on which some functional below k converges at n.
Build the recursive Y-computable chain of compatible strings realising convergence at every n.
Use the collection scheme to find an M-infinite homogeneous set on which a single index works everywhere.
Obtain the M-infinite alpha-decreasing sequence contradicting well-foundedness, and conclude.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-wf（源 522-524 行，证明 525-543 行，共 19 行）：任一条件 (sigma,rho) 都能被一个扩展强制「对每个 e<k，泛函 Phi_e^{G⊕Y} 不是长度超过某 n 的 alpha-下降序列」。关键操作不是例行核验：先用扭泛函的技巧把「收敛」变成「对更小输入收敛且值严格 alpha-下降」（526-530 行）；再假设引理失败，从而对每个相容有限串都能找到更长的相容扩展使某个 e<k 在该处收敛（532 行），据此递归构造相容串链（534-539 行）；随后必须调用 M 的 Σ^0_2 收集原则得到 M-无穷齐次集 Z，把「逐点可能是不同 e」压缩成「同一 e 在 Z 上处处收敛」（539-540 行）；最后得到与 M ⊨ WF(alpha) 矛盾的 M-无穷 alpha-下降序列（542-543 行）。难点在于把无穷多个需求同时满足到相容串链上，并精确地用齐次集把索引固定下来；原文位置在证明的 532-540 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-wf at source lines 522-524 together with the proof environment that begins on the next line (525-543); the pairing is the ordinary adjacent one.

The retained context at source lines 480-491 is the author's own account of conditions, of compatibility of a string with a condition and of the two forcing clauses for the existential and universal jump formulas; the retained context at source line 505 is his own explanation of the relation forcing a decided initial segment of the jump.

The retained preamble reproduces verbatim the author's document class at source line 2, his theorem declarations at source lines 16-25, his macro definitions at source lines 46-88 and 91, his natural-operation macros at source lines 104-107 and his quotation macro at source line 116. The LS2 font-encoding block at source lines 93-99, which declares \smashtimes through the stix fonts, is not retained because the host TeX Live has no stix directory and because the author never uses that symbol: source line 105 defines \ntimes as \dottimes and source line 110 shows the alternative already commented out. mathabx (source line 103) is retained because \dotplus and \dottimes come from it. The cleveref load at source line 6 and the inputenc load with the utf8x option at source line 8 are not retained, for the assembler's own cleveref machinery and the forced xelatex engine respectively. Nothing was renamed, redefined or added.
No retained line contains a citation or a cross-reference, so the material carries no bibliography and needs no navigation pointer.

The article's conservation theorems, its lemma lem:shore-blocking-wf, its lemma lem:wf-product, its lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-jump and its proposition prop:coh-wf are not counted here and are not used as premises.
